scope.summary: Implement typed pose/body/garment mix primitives over immutable PoseKit evidence, BodyPose assets, BodyKit recipes/channels, garment presets, and material/animation layers with region/layer weights, conflict previews, selected apply, detach, repair, and provenance.
acceptance_criteria: Mix operations are read/derive proposals until explicit selected apply through the owning API; 2D PoseKit evidence never becomes direct 3D authority.

Supports weighted pose blending, symmetry, N-pose proximity blending, region-scoped body recipe/channel mixing, garment/preset composition, layer conflict rules, compare/revert, and content-addressed provenance.
Concurrent mixes use expected versions, leases, idempotency, immutable proposals, deterministic conflict diagnostics, EventLedger receipts, and Loom-navigable refs.

MT-749 owns TailorMixGraphV1 backend authority and typed commands under 13.30 [TAI-ACT-003..005] and 13.33 [TAI-INT-002..003, TAI-INT-006]; it consumes MT-710 containment proof transitively through MT-717 and MUST return `dependency_unavailable` without private adapters, copied schemas, or guessed fixtures unless the exact PoseKit source commit is contained in merged main and the compatible WP-KERNEL-012/PoseKit/character-sheet schema receipts resolve. MT-718 exclusively owns the native mix preview, weight, conflict, selected-apply, detach, rebase, repair, and provenance projection and must consume these commands without a UI schema fork.
scope.risk_if_missed: Unbounded or UI-only mixing could silently overwrite body, pose, garment, or source authority and destroy reproducibility.

gui_obligation.not_applicable_reason: Backend-only authority contract. MT-718 is the exact owning native GUI for mix preview, region/layer weights, conflict inspection, selected apply, detach, rebase, repair, and provenance; MT-749 provides typed commands, state, receipts, diagnostics, and TraceProjection and must not claim MT-718 Argus proof.

target_entries: Tailor UserManual > Model operation, diagnostics, pillars, and manual

hbr_int_009_tier_obligations.reason: This MT owns authoritative, job, or external-tool lifecycle events and must project the same event_id, run_id, actor_id, and correlation_id from EventLedger into Flight Recorder.
This MT emits typed diagnostics through its owning command or job and inherits retention, health, and projection behavior from the shared diagnostics substrate.
The owning native shell or scheduled job supplies Palmistry coverage; this MT must preserve operation identity and recovery handles.

risks: Unbounded or UI-only mixing could silently overwrite body, pose, garment, or source authority and destroy reproducibility.
GUI, backend, agent, replay, and manual projections may drift if they do not consume the same typed authority.
minimum_controls: One typed owner and exact stable ids are required.
Negative, concurrent, cancellation, recovery, and no-context proofs are required where applicable.
No validator PASS/FAIL is inferred from this pre-activation contract.

required_changes_before_execution: Consume the signed technical refinement, canonical command/surface registries, classified HBR tiers, and task-oriented UserManual contract before execution.

requirements: Resolve Principal, AuthenticatedSession and AccessSpace before every resource read or mutation.

Use authenticated SurrealDB record-user table/field PERMISSIONS intersected with ResourceBroker-backed artifact/file handles; administrative/root credentials and UI filtering are never the security boundary. PostgreSQL and SQLite access paths are forbidden.
Derived resources preserve the intersection of source access scopes and must not leak existence through counts, search, previews, logs, traces, caches, diagnostics, exports or model context.
